finalText: Verifier passes. Migrated all 12 straggler files in `packages/` (analytics, orders, billing, support, catalog, accounts) from `db.query(sql, params)` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, leaving `cache.query` calls and the vendored `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` untouched. `node verify.js` confirms: no remaining `db.query` sites, all `db.execute` calls carry both `sql`/`params`, and every module still loads and functions correctly.
